test_title: PYST 68: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

It rain a lot in this part of the country.
solution:
The correct answer is '**It rain**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**rain**" should be in the correct tense form.
 
• The subject "**It**" should be followed by the verb "**rains**" to agree in the present tense.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are grammatically correct in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"It **rains**__ a lot in this part of the country."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "of the country"** is correct because it properly describes the location.
 
• **Option 3: "a lot"** is correct because it properly quantifies the amount of rain.
 
• **Option 4: "in this part"** is correct because it properly describes the specific area.
